title.narrative: Climate Resilient Solutions for Improving Water Governance

description.narrative: The Water Governance component aims to provide technical support to improve the capacity of water institutions at federal and provincial levels, such as water commissions, water regulatory authorities and irrigation departments, through data-backed water accounting and sectoral allocation. This component is being delivered through the International Water Management Institute (IWMI).
